brief: 5 signs you're a people pleaser and how to stop today.

slots.title: PEOPLE PLEASER? FIVE SIGNS TO SPOT
YOU APOLOGIZE FOR EVERYTHING
slots.body: You say sorry when it's not your fault. You absorb blame to keep the peace. This erodes your self-respect fast.

slots.title: YOU CAN'T SAY NO
slots.body: Your calendar is full of tasks you resent. You fear disappointing others more than draining yourself. Boundaries feel impossible to set.

slots.title: YOU NEED CONSTANT VALIDATION
slots.body: You rely on outside praise to feel worthy. One critical comment ruins your entire day. Your mood depends on others' opinions.

slots.title: YOU IGNORE YOUR OWN NEEDS
slots.body: You silence your preferences to avoid conflict. Hunger, rest, and goals all come second. Eventually, resentment replaces your kindness.

slots.title: YOU CHANGE TO PLEASE OTHERS
slots.body: You agree with ideas you secretly hate. Your personality shifts depending on who's around. You have lost touch with who you are.

slots.title: HOW TO STOP TODAY
slots.body: Practice saying no without a long explanation, and name your needs before checking the room. Reclaim your time; your peace is non-negotiable.

slots.headline: BREAK FREE FROM THE CYCLE
slots.body: Pick one boundary to enforce this week. Your growth starts with one honest no.
